record.edic_text:
1142 daimon {dah'-ee-mown}

from daio (to distribute fortunes); TDNT - 2:1,137; n m/f

AV - devils 4, devil 1; 5

1) a god, a goddess
   1a) an inferior deity, whether good or bad
2) in the NT, an evil spirit
